defect_one_liner: reply.callNotFound() skipped the not-found handler's preHandler when the route was registered before setNotFoundHandler() (stale context snapshot taken before preReady hooks ran)
confirmation: PR #6965 documents the stale lifecycle-snapshot root cause and reproduction

defect_one_liner: A preClose hook added to a Fastify instance executed once per instance in the encapsulation subtree instead of exactly once for the declaring instance
confirmation: PR #6940 reproduction with a hook counter firing multiple times

defect_one_liner: deepMerge allowed prototype pollution through source option keys, reachable via browser-mode screenshot matcher options
confirmation: PR #11215 body describes the pollution path and reachable sink

defect_one_liner: Automocking traversed recursive prototype chains, breaking mocking of self-referential objects
Error decoration threw on non-string dummy.stack (global Error.prepareStackTrace instrumentation), masking the original request error
Vapor-mode components that failed before mounting were never disposed on app.unmount (leaked instances, stale HMR registrations)
confirmation: PR #15457 bug-fix release notes describe the unmount cleanup failure

defect_one_liner: Router mis-validated trim_prefix for unanchored RegExp routes, executing middleware on wrong paths
Panic ('invalid node type') in findCaseInsensitivePathRec with RedirectFixedPath on unmatched request paths (wildChild mis-handled)
Context.Copy() dropped the Errors and Accepted fields, losing error and content-negotiation state in the copy
SaveUploadedFile chmod'ed pre-existing destination directories, failing with 'chmod /tmp: operation not permitted' (v1.12.0 regression)
Mounting a router onto itself (via With/Group sharing the tree) caused an infinite loop on non-matching requests instead of 404
Handlers sharing a pattern with a Route()/Mount() call were silently dropped and invisible to Walk()/Routes()
Completion getCompletions() mutated os.Args in place by appending '--' into the shared backing array (append with spare capacity)
confirmation: PR #2356 with regression test proving os.Args unmodified

defect_one_liner: extractors.FromParam double-decoded path parameters when UnescapePath:true (router had already decoded the path)
confirmation: PR #4626 'Decode a path parameter exactly once' (fix item of issue #4604)

defect_one_liner: Res.Vary() compared field names case-sensitively, emitting RFC-violating 'Vary: accept, Accept'
confirmation: PR #4642 cites RFC 9110 Section 5.1 case-insensitivity with repro

defect_one_liner: _encode_files failed to detect file-like wrappers exposed via __getattr__ (e.g. mocks), mis-encoding request bodies
ufunc.accumulate crashed on mismatched out shape and could read uninitialized memory building the error message
np.median/quantile/percentile with tuple axis raised ValueError 'cannot reshape array of size 0' when a kept axis had size 0
np.strings.replace truncated plain-Python-string old/new to the input's fixed itemsize before replacement
Routing used .partition(":") on potential IPv6 hosts, splitting addresses at the wrong colon
provide_automatic_options=True could not enable automatic OPTIONS handling (only disabling was honored)
confirmation: PR #5917 explains OPTIONS was only added when the flag was not passed

defect_one_liner: bytearray.take_bytes() corrupted CPython's shared single-byte singletons (mutating interned b'\x00')
confirmation: gh-156995 (linked in PR #157260; main-branch fix GH-156996), maintainer-merged with regression tests

defect_one_liner: spawn_blocking could hang forever when the OS refused to create the first blocking-pool thread (scheduler workers miscounted as blocking threads)
confirmation: PR #8408 motivation documents the hang and accounting error

defect_one_liner: Generated serialize_struct code hit E0716 'temporary value dropped while borrowed' under Rust 2024 edition, breaking user builds
confirmation: PR #2950 includes the real E0716 compiler error from a derive user

defect_one_liner: Unit variant of a flattened externally tagged enum deserialized but could not serialize, breaking roundtrip consistency
confirmation: PR #2786 with failing roundtrip playground repro

defect_one_liner: Merging MethodRouters produced Allow headers with duplicates ('GET,HEAD,HEAD')
Nested error downcast in axum-core failed to reach the inner error for nested services, so HandleError extracted the wrong type
Unresolved IPv6 InetSocketAddress serialized without brackets, producing invalid '2001:db8::1:443' output
confirmation: PR #6186: 'Fixes #6185' contrasting resolved vs unresolved branches

defect_one_liner: JsonPrimitive.hashCode violated the equals/hashCode contract across equal numbers with different Number backing types, breaking HashSet/HashMap membership
peekNumber's leading-zero octal check overflowed, so STRICT mode rejected valid numerals like 2^64 + '0'
confirmation: PR #3034 explains the overflow in JsonReader.peekNumber

defect_one_liner: Feature promotion: renames experimental_clearCache to clearCache with deprecated alias
confirmation: PR #11086 'feat: promote clearCache out of experimental' — API promotion, no defect
